effects: Pulls exactly `assets` USDT from the signer into the vault (safeTransferFrom(caller, this, assets) in Vault._deposit).
Mints vault shares to `receiver`; the number is computed from (assets − deposit fee) at the current share price and rounded down (Vault.deposit / _previewDeposit).
Keeps a deposit fee, set in storage (_depositFee), out of the deposited USDT; it lowers the shares minted and is booked to the fee dispatcher.
Spends the signer's USDT allowance to the vault.
Mints reward-fee shares to the vault before pricing (_accrueRewardFee), which dilutes the share price slightly.
formats.shown: Deposit: 0.5 USDT, share ticker kEulerUSDT, shares sent to the receiver address.

findings.title: deposit: the 'Share ticker' constant says kEulerUSDT, but the vault's share token symbol is keeyUSDT.
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.vaultTicker = "kEulerUSDT", shown as 'Share ticker'. Case 0 mined: the shares minted to the signer have symbol "keeyUSDT" (asset 0xdb76…7f0e). The proxy constructor args hold the symbol 'keeyUSDT' and the name 'Kiln EULER Euler Yield USDT'.
findings.fix: Set vaultTicker to "keeyUSDT", or drop the constant and show the share token from @.to.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received and the deposit fee are computed on chain and not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.deposit: (_shares, _depositFeeAmount) = _previewDeposit(assets, _accrueRewardFee(), totalSupply()). The fee rate comes from storage $._depositFee. Case 0: the signer received 499990 keeyUSDT, and that amount is not on the screen.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The function has no minShares parameter.

findings.title: deposit: the intent is just 'Deposit', with no interpolatedIntent naming the amount or the receiver.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for vault shares to {receiver}".

cases.notes: The screen shows 0.5 USDT out correctly. The shares go to the signer, but their amount (0.49999) is not shown and the ticker shown, kEulerUSDT, is not the on-chain symbol keeyUSDT.

effects: Pulls a computed USDT amount from the signer: the cost of the shares plus the deposit fee, rounded up (_previewMint). This amount is not in calldata and has no maximum.
Spends the signer's USDT allowance to the vault.
Mints reward-fee shares to the vault before pricing.
formats.shown: Mint: deposit asset USDT, minted shares amount, shares sent to the receiver address.

findings.title: mint: the USDT amount taken from the signer is computed on chain and has no bound on screen.
findings.evidence: Vault.mint: (_assets, _depositFeeAmount) = _previewMint(shares, _newTotalAssets, _newTotalSupply); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, _assets, ...). The descriptor shows only 'Deposit asset' = USDT (raw constant).
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor (there is no maxAssets parameter). The USDT allowance is the only bound.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' does not say that USDT is paid for the shares.
findings.fix: Use intent "Deposit USDT for shares" and interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} to {receiver} by paying USDT".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns a computed number of the owner's shares, rounded up, to cover `assets` (Vault.withdraw).
If the caller is not the owner, spends the owner's share allowance to the caller.
Withdraws `assets` from Euler through the connector and sends the USDT balance gained to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw: exactly the given USDT amount, sent to the receiver, from the owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned is computed on chain and not shown.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The function has no maxShares parameter.

findings.title: withdraw: 'Withdraw exactly' depends on the connector returning exactly `assets`; the receiver gets the vault's balance delta.
findings.evidence: Vault._withdraw: _connector.functionDelegateCall(IConnector.withdraw(asset, assets)); SafeERC20.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, balanceOf(this) - _balanceBefore). The connector source is not in the directory.
findings.fix: None needed if the Euler connector withdraws exactly. Otherwise relabel the field 'Withdraw'.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` from `owner` (the signer in the case).
If the caller is not the owner, spends the owner's share allowance.
Sends USDT to `receiver`. The amount is computed from the shares at the current price (rounded down) and is not bounded by any parameter.
formats.shown: Redeem: shares to redeem (1.49999 kEulerUSDT), to the receiver, from the owner. Nothing says USDT comes back.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says USDT is received; the underlying asset is missing although mint shows it.
findings.evidence: Vault._withdraw safeTransfer(IERC20(asset()), receiver, ...). Case 1 mined: the signer received 1539377 USDT (signer in). The descriptor redeem fields are shares, receiver and owner only. The reader guessed 'presumably USDT'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and an interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for USDT to {receiver}".

findings.title: redeem: the USDT amount received is computed on chain, with no minimum in calldata.
findings.evidence: Vault.redeem: _assets = _convertToAssets(shares, Math.Rounding.Floor, _newTotalAssets, _newTotalSupply). Case 1: 1.539377 USDT received, not shown.

cases.notes: The screen shows 1.49999 shares out correctly. The 1.539377 USDT received is not stated, neither the asset nor the amount; the reader guessed USDT.

couldNotCheck: The connector called by delegatecall through ConnectorRegistry (0xde63817c82e93499357ae198518f90ac1be93a72, connector EULER_YIELD_USDT) is not in the directory. It sets totalAssets(), which prices the shares, and the USDT balance delta paid to the receiver in withdraw and redeem.
